_comment: Filers the automatic matcher can't place. Key: the filer's key as the build log prints it, e.g. 'senate|McConnell, Jr.|A. Mitchell' or 'house|Pelosi|Nancy|CA'. Value: a bioguide ID from https://bioguide.congress.gov, or "candidate" for someone who files trade reports while running for Congress but has never been a member. The build log lists unmatched members.
